description.value: Handsome Dan's is a vacation rental management company offering over 30 unique cottages and homes in Port Renfrew and beyond, ranging from oceanfront properties to modern inland retreats. Originally founded by 'Handsome Dan and The French Girl' and taken over by Ken and Joy in 2020, the company manages self-catering properties with fully-equipped kitchens and coastal character. Port Renfrew sits at the trailhead of the Juan de Fuca Marine Trail and is a popular endpoint on the West Coast cycling route, making a self-catering cottage a practical base for touring cyclists in the area.
